films.title: To the Devil a Daughter
films.overview: An American occult novelist battles to save the soul of a young girl from a group of Satanists, led by an excommunicated priest, who plan on using her as the representative of the Devil on Earth.

films.title: Demons of the Mind
films.overview: A physician discovers that two children are being kept virtually imprisoned in their house by their father. He investigates, and discovers a web of sex, incest and satanic possession.

films.title: Jesus
films.overview: Three and a half years of Jesus' ministry, as told in the Gospel of Luke.
